article.title: Red Scare in Puerto Rico: A Hidden History
article.author: Democratic Left
article.content: Post-World War II anti-communist hysteria hit Puerto Rico through legal assaults and J. Edgar Hoover’s clandestine tricks. Although the FBI met unexpected resistance, the strategy cemented Puerto Rico’s status as a powerless “commonwealth.” The post Red Scare in Puerto Rico: A Hidden History appeared first on Democratic Left .
